newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Auckland housing mkt still looking firm - survey.
newsitem.headline: Auckland housing mkt still looking firm - survey.

text.p: The Auckland region's residential property market will remain firm during the next six months according a panel of property experts, the New Zealand Press Association reported on Monday.
Massey University's real estate analysis unit said its latest quarterly survey of Auckland property experts indicated expectations were fairly evenly distributed.
"Forty four percent anticipate the market improving and 49 percent anticipate it staying the same," unit spokesman Garry Dowse said.
He said analysis indicated all market sectors were generally positive and both the price and volume of sales were likely to stay the same or trend upwards in the next three months.
Dowse said housing at the lower priced end of the market had the most positive outlook.
"Comments provided suggest there is noticeable investor and first home buyer demand up to $250,000."
Units, apartments and higher priced housing appeared the least positive.
